images.caption: Figure 1:Architecture Overview of SPAR.Starting from a common VLA[8,9], SPAR extends it with a generation expert that mirrors the action expert design, and predicts the representation of the future visual state simultaneously. Robot data supervises both experts, while the egocentric videos supervise only the generation expert. The VLM backbone can therefore be optimized with heterogeneous data composition. The generation expert is removed at inference.
